tools.description: Search codebases using ast-grep patterns for straightforward structural matches. (returns json)

dir.description: The directory to search in. If not specified, will use the current working directory.

lang.description: The language of the code. If not specified, will be auto-detected based on file extensions.

pattern.description: The ast-grep pattern to search for. Note, the pattern must have valid AST structure.

tools.name: ast-grep
